errors.evidence: The phrase '显著高于其他类别' (significantly higher than other categories) constitutes an interpretation of the data, which the prompt instructs to avoid. The description should remain objective and avoid subjective or evaluative language.

The description incorrectly identifies the category '性格' (character), with a value of 44, as the lowest. The chart clearly shows that the categories '时间' (time) and '频数' (frequency) are the lowest, both with a value of 13.
